name: Kaga (carrier conversion)
dimensionBasis: Existing recognition drawing dimensions (see its measurement caveats)

reference.configuration: Kaga original 1928–30 carrier conversion: three deck levels, no island, a horizontal shortened upper landing deck, two pole masts and long side exhaust ducts discharging aft. Two twin 200 mm turrets forward and six single aft casemate guns, with near-side mounts visible. The aft-running exhaust trunk distinguishes Kaga from Akagi; the post-1935 island and full-length deck are excluded.
